tagline: A soft, open sherpa mattress for the dog who won't lie in a bed with sides.
lead: Your dog can sprawl diagonally, legs out, on warm sherpa, with no sides to hem them in.
value: Stonewashed fabric, sherpa and leather handles are the parts you touch every day, and the first cut on cheaper beds.
intro: Moss is an open pillow dog mattress with a green stonewashed exterior, a sherpa-style sleeping surface, virgin fibre cushioning, leather handles and a removable cover that machine washes at 30°C. Medium and Large.
points: An open pillow they can flop onto from any direction.
A soft, warm surface over virgin fibre cushioning.
Fibre filled by design. If your dog needs firm support, choose a memory foam bed.
Move it one-handed from the kitchen to beside the sofa.
It comes off and goes in the machine at 30°C.
best_for: Sprawlers who sleep diagonally and change position through the night, and dogs who sleep on the floor beside a bed with sides.
fit_note: The whole surface is usable, so measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Both sizes are 20cm deep. Between Medium and Large? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and machine wash at 30°C. Air-dry only. The leather handles have their own care instructions.
seo_title: Soft Sherpa Dog Mattress, No Sides | Snoozly
seo_description: A soft sherpa dog mattress with no sides, for dogs who sprawl. Green stonewashed fabric, fibre filling, leather handles, washes at 30°C. Medium and Large.
